intent: Add a VLAN with its ID and name; when the request names a VLAN group, assign that group.
second_installation: a required custom field 'Cost center' on VLANs; requests now carry a cost center

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: NetBox (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9486/ipam/vlans/add/
  version: netbox@4.1.11
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sql_driver: pg8000.dbapi
  sql_connect_args: {host: 127.0.0.1, port: 9489, user: nb_reader, database: netbox}
  sql_password_env: NB_READER_PASSWORD
  sql_query: "SELECT v.vid::text AS vid, v.name, COALESCE(g.name, '') AS vlan_group, COALESCE(v.custom_field_data->>'cost_center', '') AS cost_center FROM ipam_vlan v LEFT JOIN ipam_vlangroup g ON g.id=v.group_id"
record:
  name: vlan
  match: [name]
  duplicate_key: name
  fields:
    vid: vid
    name: name
    vlan_group: group
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
campaign:
  id: onboarding-nb-vlan-conditional-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
